name: mirage
text: Answers so far: (3) Yes: every Bids-tab setting is mirrored to the engine (cloud-config, classed BIDS in CloudScanKey) and the engine re-makes its bid lines under them. (1) Kalshi bids need two switches that are OFF by default (Kalshi › Setup: Place orders on Kalshi, and Kalshi bids); I'm confirming that's the whole cause. (2) Building a separate Kalshi money card on the Engine tab now.
